verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents a local browser mode: localBrowser.launch starts a local browser, and localBrowser.connect attaches over CDP to a Chromium you already run, with a persistent local user-data directory. The docs never say this mode works without any Browserbase or other cloud account, and caching is described as server-side, so the 'no cloud account' part is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation that local mode needs no Browserbase or cloud account, clarity on whether features like caching work fully offline or locally, and hands-on or independent corroboration of a local-only dev workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a local browser on my own machine for development, without any cloud account

citations.quote: Attach to any Chromium browser you are already running, by URL
Stagehand creates the directory if it does not exist and leaves it in place after the browser shuts down, so the next run starts from the same cookies and local storage
